Roof Plumbing & Re-Roofing in Merricks North

Sandhurst Roofing is a family owned roofing business with more than 30 years of experience looking after homes right across Merricks North. From re-roofs in COLORBOND® steel and roof plumbing to guttering and tile to tin conversions, we back every job with honest advice and quality workmanship.

Larger blocks, sheds and treed sites are part of the job in Merricks North, and we are used to roofs that need more than a quick once-over. Call Steve on 0448 812 800 for a free, no-obligation quote.

Get a Free Quote!

Roofs in Merricks North: What We Commonly See

Merricks North is hinterland country, a patchwork of vineyards, small farms and rural-residential acreage set back from the Western Port coast. The homes here tend to be larger, on bigger blocks, often with a shed, garage or stables alongside the house. Set among gum trees and pasture, the roofs deal less with salt and more with harsh summer UV, gum-leaf litter and exposure to wind across open country.

The jobs we are called out for most in Merricks North are refixing cracked ridge capping, clearing and replacing gutters that fill with leaf and bark litter, and re-roofing or re-sheeting larger home and shed roofs that have faded and worn.

Re-Roofing & Roof Replacement in Merricks North

On larger blocks a roof is a bigger investment, and replacing one properly pays off for decades. We re-roof Merricks North homes, sheds and outbuildings in COLORBOND® steel, which is light, strong and low maintenance, and handles heat, wind and heavy leaf litter well.

Many older homes were built with roofs that contain asbestos cement sheeting. If that is your roof, we handle safe asbestos roof removal and replacement and finish the job in new COLORBOND® steel. We also convert older roofs to metal with our tile to tin service, and we will tell you honestly which option suits your home.

Roof Plumbing & Guttering in Merricks North

Larger roofs and treed blocks put a lot of water and debris through the gutters. Our registered roof plumbers handle flashings, valleys, ridge capping, box gutters and downpipes, and can connect rainwater tanks and stormwater so the water ends up where it should.

Whether you need one section of guttering replaced or a full re-gutter with matching downpipes in COLORBOND® steel, we will quote it clearly and finish it neatly. Small jobs such as gutter repairs are no problem either.

What Affects the Cost of Roofing in Merricks North

Your quote depends on what your roof actually needs. Roof size, pitch and access, the type of steel and colour you choose, and how much plumbing work is involved are the main factors. We give you a clear written quote after an on-site inspection, so you know what you are paying for before any work starts.

Our Merricks North Roofing Process

It starts with a free on-site inspection and a written quote. Once you approve it we strip the existing roof, check and prepare the framing, then install new COLORBOND® steel sheeting, flashings and ridge capping, along with new guttering and downpipes where they are part of the job. Every job finishes with a clean site.

Why Merricks North Locals Choose Sandhurst Roofing

Merricks North locals choose Sandhurst Roofing because we turn up when we say we will, do quality work and charge a fair price. We are fully licensed and insured, with registered roof plumbers on the team, and we explain what is happening every step of the way. Have a look at the COLORBOND® colour chart to start choosing your colour.

Merricks North Roofing FAQs

Do you work on sheds and outbuildings as well as the house?

Yes. We re-sheet and re-roof sheds, garages, stables and other outbuildings in metal, as well as the main house.

Can you fix gutters that fill with leaves and bark?

Yes. We replace overflowing gutters and valleys, and can fit systems that cope better with heavy leaf litter on treed blocks.

Do you offer free quotes?

Yes, every quote is free and without obligation. Call Steve on 0448 812 800.
